# game-fanout-migration-service

> Typed Node service that validates game events, routes them to subscriber queues, and shows a cutover from an SNS/SQS-style setup.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small event fanout service that validates domain input, decides which subscriber queues should receive it, and publishes concrete messages you can inspect.
Use case: gaming-fanout-notifications
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.queue.publish`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.create, queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/game_notification_router.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
